questions.subject: chemistry
questions.content:
For the following three reactions a, b and c, equilibrium constants are given:
a. CO (g) + H2O (g) CO2(g) + H2 (g) ; K1
b. CH4 (g) + H2O (g) CO(g) + 3H2 (g) ; K2
c. CH4 (g) + 2H2O (g) CO2(g) + 4H2 (g) ; K3
